description: Redesign the Create Lesson form (mode picker is no longer full-horizontal, add difficulty selector, estimated duration, recent struggles) and add new dashboard features (achievement badges, learning goals, motivational quotes, parent tips, time spent today widget) to fill empty spaces
steps: DASHBOARD TAB - Add new widgets to fill empty spaces in src/app/parent/page.tsx dashboard section: (1) A 'Today's Learning' widget showing time spent and lessons completed today with a daily goal ring/progress indicator, (2) A 'Motivational' card with rotating encouraging messages for parents (e.g. 'Consistency beats intensity', 'Small steps lead to big progress'), (3) An 'Achievement Badges' section showing milestones (First Lesson, 3-Day Streak, 5-Day Streak, 10 Lessons, Subject Explorer, Perfect Score) with earned/locked states, (4) A 'Recommended Next' card suggesting a subject/topic based on weakest areas. Place these between the Weekly Activity/Quick Actions row and the Recent Lessons section.

CREATE TAB REDESIGN in src/app/parent/page.tsx: (1) Change the mode picker from vertical stacked full-width cards to a side-by-side 2-column grid with larger illustrations/icons and a selected state that is more visually distinct (checkmark badge, stronger border). (2) Add a difficulty/level selector below mode picker in the sidebar (Beginner/Intermediate/Advanced radio buttons or pill toggles). (3) Add an estimated duration indicator below the difficulty selector showing '~5-8 min' for board mode and '~8-12 min' for story mode. (4) Add a 'Recent Struggles' section at the bottom of the sidebar showing last 3 struggles from lesson history so parents can quickly regenerate similar lessons with one click. (5) Make subject icons larger (h-8 w-8) and add a subtle background gradient to the selected state for more playful feel.
Update src/lib/types.ts to add an optional 'difficulty' field to the LessonRequest type (type LessonDifficulty = 'beginner' | 'intermediate' | 'advanced')
Update src/lib/gemini.ts buildUserPrompt function to include the difficulty level in the prompt sent to the AI if provided
Update src/app/api/generate-lesson/route.ts to pass through the difficulty field from the request body

Create the achievement badge data and logic: define badge types and conditions in a new section at the top of parent/page.tsx (or a small utility). Badges are computed from stats (lesson count, streak, subjects explored, accuracy). Display them as a grid of small circular icons with labels.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard tab has new widgets: Today's Learning goal ring, motivational card, achievement badges grid, recommended next lesson card
Create tab mode picker shows as side-by-side cards (grid-cols-2), not full-width stacked blocks
Create tab has a difficulty selector (beginner/intermediate/advanced)
Create tab shows estimated duration based on mode selection
Create tab sidebar shows recent struggles from history for quick re-generation
Subject icons are larger (h-8 w-8) and selected state has gradient background
LessonRequest type includes optional difficulty field
The difficulty is included in the AI prompt when provided
verification: Run npm run build and confirm no errors
Run npm run lint and confirm no errors
